name: hidden_failed_check
description: A planted negative is written from a ledger that hides one failed check the record has. The brief misses that check, and only that planted item.
anchor: candidate: kind-A trace check (brief section 3) refuses a negative that misses or alters anything besides its one planted check

name: hidden_tripwire
description: A planted negative is written from a ledger that hides one tripwire the record touches. The brief names every other tripwire and misses that one. The hidden tripwire is one of B004-B012.
anchor: candidate: kind-A trace check (brief section 3) refuses a negative that hides anything besides its one planted tripwire
